cards.title: Today
cards.do: set your energy, report statuses or Catch up; Pause and Resume; the menu bar shows now and next.
cards.rule: only you mark Done; paused time counts nowhere; at 22:00 what's left reads Not done · no reply, or · paused.

cards.title: Plans
cards.do: compare up to 3 drafts, set one, or ask Ava to replace it.
cards.rule: plans fill 09:00–22:00; a fixed-time task can be at any hour. Only today's plan can be set.

cards.title: Calendar
cards.do: pick a day for its plan and tasks; read day, week, month and all-time reports.
cards.rule: past days are read-only; ask Ava to change a past task.

cards.title: Patterns
cards.do: open Calendar's Patterns tab; choose Week, Month or All time; hover or tab through a graph for figures.
cards.rule: only recorded times count; times to check, or awaiting a status, stay out; graphs need enough data.

cards.title: Goals
cards.do: create, pause, resume or complete a goal; open it for its tasks, and a Learning goal's Library.
cards.rule: a goal's area is fixed; remove or unlink its tasks before removing it.

cards.title: Tasks
cards.do: add, edit and filter by area, over the last 14 days and the next 60.
cards.rule: a task with no length gets an estimate of at least 30 min; Learn tasks using Library items stay there.

cards.title: Learning tasks
cards.for: studying a file or a website.
cards.do: make one from a source; tick its checklist or add your own items; “Continue next session” keeps your ticks.
cards.rule: only you mark Done; a website is checked when made and when the task starts.

cards.title: Areas
cards.do: check today's tasks, the agent's notes and the area's cards; add anything from “+ Add” at the top.
cards.rule: Work, someone expects it. Project, building something with an end. Learn, getting better. Life, everything else.

cards.title: Library
cards.for: what you study: notes, files, folders, websites.
cards.do: add them; link them from Learn tasks, or make learning tasks from them; open each in its app or website.
cards.rule: Ava checks folders' new files; websites go online only for their learning tasks.

cards.title: Ava
cards.do: add, move, shorten, repeat or remove tasks; start goals; change meals or plans; link Library items to Learn tasks.
cards.rule: nothing changes until you press Confirm.

cards.title: Agents
cards.do: read their notes on area pages and in Ava; they learn lengths from the time Done tasks took.
cards.rule: the Orchestrator proposes; agents estimate only lengths you didn't set, never from skipped or unanswered tasks.

cards.title: Past days
cards.do: through Ava, correct a status or the time a task took, remove it, or move it to today or later.
cards.rule: its planned time and length stay; yesterday's tasks to fix show on Today.

cards.title: Meals
cards.do: ask Ava to change a meal for one day, or from a day on.
cards.rule: no task can overlap a meal.

cards.title: Repeats
cards.do: set daily or weekly; stop or switch it through Ava.
cards.rule: a change made from a past day applies from today on, or tomorrow if today's is already reported or planned.

cards.title: Energy
cards.do: tap 1–5 at the top of Today, or tell Ava; change it any time today.
cards.rule: the day's average counts; 2 or below suggests Lighter day, 4 or above Deep focus.
